correctness.rationale: In characteristic different from two, square-zero classes in M/M^2 are exactly V union W. Unequal dimensions force algebra automorphisms to preserve these components; commutation on M/M^2 and M^2 forces Q=cI and R=cI, with c(c+lambda)=0. Equal dimensions and equal ranks are equivalent to similarity under the quadratic relation, providing factorwise isomorphisms. The explicit 15-dimensional witness and all rational-ratio cases follow. Standalone checker verifies identities and ranks in three finite fields, but these are supplementary to the general argument.

value.rationale: The result exactly resolves the natural pairwise reversal-isomorphism problem for an infinite, structurally motivated class and answers the originating paper's fixed-intermediate-ratio braiding issue negatively for the full ratio subcategories. Balanced rank is not sufficient even for linear similarity in dimension fifteen, exposing a structural invariant invisible to the published rank test.
